digest: Classify the actual task message before start, resume, archive, commit, or delegation.
Structured delegation envelopes override project bootstrap text.
readWhen: when prompt and bootstrap text conflict

digest: Hard delegation uses COWORK_DELEGATION_V1, COWORK_ACK, then EXECUTE.
Soft/default delegated work is advisory and cannot satisfy formal Implement or Check.
Formal subagent work requires dispatchSubagent, freshChildContext, waitChild, listChildren, and cancelChild.
Missing required host capabilities fall back to inline_or_manual.
readWhen: when adding or changing host adapters

digest: Adapter declarations must define capabilities, dispatch, contracts, and fallback.
Adapters describe host primitives; workflow.md stays host-neutral.
readWhen: before adding a new host adapter
